item.title: Yamanai Ane wa Nai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tangerine
  • 発売日: 2014-05-30
  • スコア: 6.05/10 (26 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 病マナヒ姉ハ無ヒ
  • 英語名: Yamanai Ane wa Nai

别名

  • Yamiane

あらすじ

Mukudori loves her younger brother, Kouji.

One day, she sees him masturbating to his teacher’s photos and gets jealous.

“Kouji is mine and only mine…!”

Since then, Mukudori has been sick; so much so that she decides to lock him up in the storehouse next to their home.

There, she ties him up, tramples him… all to make him an obedient slave…

  • スコア: 6.26/10 (28 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 処女ママ
  • 英語名: Shojo Mama

あらすじ

The protagonist is living in a motherless home. His father is always out for business as well so he starves for parental affection.

His father found a girl and will marry her in his return from business trip. His new mother has to boot up into his family so she came to their home to live there in advance. This delighted him very much and welcomes her wholeheartedly. His sister, who has an Electra complex, welcome her in a bad grace.

  • 日本語名: セイント～あぁ主よ、教え子達に堕とされた私をお許し下さい～
  • 英語名: Saint Aa Shu yo, Oshiego-tachi ni Otosareta Watashi o Oyurushi Kudasai

あらすじ

The story is about a church that serves as an orphanage in a remote location. A troubled boy named Ren is admitted and gains the ability to control people’s actions one day. He uses his power to make his companions indulged in sexual pleasure, but his desire gradually gets out of control and he targets a female teacher who resembles his mother. The teacher is assaulted by her students with pleasure so intense that it breaks her psyche. Eventually, the entire school becomes a paradise of lewdness.
